scalars.scalar_value: Three (3) years Patient Access experience in large, complex healthcare environment.

items.item_text: Knowledge and articulation of birth certification documents and hospital patient forms, as required by JACAHO/GAD, etc.
Participates in 7/24 on-call rotation, finding coverage for call outs.

Must be available to work a flexible schedule, including various hours, days, shifts, and on-call assignments, and be able to work at all Medical Center locations (EC, LJ, and HC) in support of 24-hour operations
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Three (3) years Patient Access experience in large, complex healthcare environment.
Epic Registration experience.
Lead or Supervisory experience.
UCSD Health patient access experience.
Prior cash handling experience.

UC San Diego Health's Revenue Cycle department supports the organization's mission to deliver outstanding patient care and to create a healthier world — one life at a time. We are a diverse, patient-focused, high-performing team with a commitment to quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement that enables us to deliver the maximum standard of care to our patients. We offer challenging career opportunities in a fast-paced and innovative environment and we embrace individuals who demonstrate a deep passion for problem-solving and customer service.

Under general supervision, the Patient Access Lead is responsible for overseeing day to day staff duties. Typical duties include staff coverage for all patient access department points of entry, performing patient account analysis to ensure accounts are financially secured, and reducing financial loss for the organization. Serves as a liaison for physician/patient care staff and patient/families. Registers patients, birth certificate completions, provides training and technical resource to staff, assists management in assessing problem areas related to accuracy and procedural deficiencies, and complies with cash handling standards.
Familiar with hospital patient access systems.
Vital Records, completion of Birth Certificates.
Advance knowledge of Patient Access, Admissions and Registration functions; inpatient, outpatient, radiology and emergency room.
Strong knowledge of third-party payors including federal, state, and private health plans.
Thorough knowledge of insurance verification, registration, and medical terminology.
Proven understanding of the patient referral and authorization process.
Highly proficient with MS Office: Outlook, Word, and Excel. Computer skills/ability to work between multiple systems accurately and efficiently.

Strong problem-solving skills. Ability to use good judgment by applying these skills to assist team members, customers and ensure expectations are met. Solid organizational skills with independent ability to set priorities, meet deadlines, and manage conflicting demands with limited supervision.
Superb customer service skills. Excellent communication skills.

Ability to interact effectively with the public, patients, visitors, clinical support staff and vendors. Ability to work in an interactive and collaborative environment. Excellent customer service skills. Self-starter who is accountable and requires minimal direction and supervision.
